0022600140.text: The New Orleans Pelicans, 0-3 and on a three-game losing streak, host the Denver Nuggets, who are 1-1 and riding a one-game winning streak. The Pelicans sit 13th in the West and trail the 5th-place Southwest standings by 3 games, while Denver is 7th in the West. Yves Missi is out for New Orleans with a knee bruise, having averaged 9.5 points and 19.6 minutes per game this season, and Denver is without Alpha Diallo (wrist), Julian Strawther (knee sprain), and Spencer Jones (hamstring). The Pelicans trail 0-1 in the 2026-27 season series after a 141-135 loss in Denver on October 24, and they lost 0-3 to Denver in the 2025-26 season series.
